query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website** at **python.org/downloads**.

The official Python website automatically detects your operating system and provides the appropriate installer for:

- **Windows** (.exe installer)
- **macOS** (.pkg installer)
- **Linux/Unix** (source code tarball)

To download:

1. Visit **https://www.python.org/downloads/**
2. The page will show the latest stable release (currently Python 3.13.x or newer)
3. Click the download button for your operating system, or select a specific version from the list

For specific versions, you can also browse all releases at **https://www.python.org/downloads/release/** or visit the Python source repository.

**Important tips:**
- Always download from the official Python website to avoid malware or outdated versions
- On Windows, make sure to check **"Add Python to PATH"** during installation
- Python 3 is the current standard — avoid Python 2 as it's no longer supported

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/
2. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/download-and-install-python-3-latest-version/
3. https://academify.com.br/en/how-to-install-python-on-your-pc/
4. https://phoenixnap.com/kb/latest-python-version
5. https://www.liquidweb.com/blog/latest-python-version/
6. https://python.p2hp.com/downloads/
